source: COMPOSED from the SDK types (@google/genai v2.27.0 src/types.ts: GenerateContentResponse, Candidate, GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata) and the Agent Platform REST reference https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/rest/v1/GenerateContentResponse (2026-10-06). Values invented; usage arithmetic follows the documented rule totalTokenCount = prompt + candidates + toolUsePrompt + thoughts; cachedContentTokenCount is a subset of promptTokenCount. Includes a thought-summary part (only present with includeThoughts: true) to prove it is NOT returned as text.
